fusions.name: Flushed Bile
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Draws the poison out of your blood into a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Rinse
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A strike that deals 18 damage and draws every affliction out of the target at once, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sluiced Clean
fusions.desc: Sluices you and every ally down, removing up to 3 poison conditions from each and restoring 10 health.

fusions.name: Bitter Ebb
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, what it drew drains back to you: you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
